messages:
alex: Heads-up: pods Pending in eu-west GPU pools. CA keeps adding 1x A100 time-slice nodes but scheduler refuses to pack because we have a mix of MIG-only and time-slice nodepools. Also hitting ENI/EBS quota warnings when CA scales across AZs.

maria: Screenshot of events? which workloads are blocked?

alex: Pod event dump: "0/12 nodes are available: 4 node(s) had taints that the pod didn't tolerate, 8 Insufficient nvidia.com/gpu". CA logs show scale-up/scale-down thrash.

derek: Short-term mitigation plan: 1) pin latency-sensitive pods to a dedicated time-slice nodepool (taint + toleration), 2) increase CA scaleDownDelay and scaleUpCooldown, 3) limit cross-AZ surge to 1 AZ.

li: Agree. Add CA expander=most-pods and prefer spreading to AZs with available ENI capacity so we don't hit quota spikes. Also set nodepool maxSurgeAZs=1.

alex: Proposed quick patch for eu-west canary:
```
apiVersion: infra.redwood/v1
kind: NodePool
metadata:
  name: gpu-time-slice-eu-canary
spec:
  taints: ["gpu:sharing=time-slice:NoSchedule"]
  autoscaler:
    scaleDownDelay: 600s  # 10m
    scaleUpCooldown: 360s  # 6m
    maxSurgeAZs: 1
    expander: MostPods
```

maria: +1 to patch. Also start a temporary routing fallback: latency-sensitive inference -> hosted regional fallback models while we stabilize. Low risk and reduces customer impact.

derek: Long-term stuff: we need kube-scheduler affinity by sharing-mode (MIG vs timeslice) or a scheduler plugin that models 'gpu.sharing_mode' as an opaque resource for binpacking. CA could then prefer nodes with matching sharing_mode.

li: Also can we add an autoscaler predicate plugin: prefer_same_sharing_mode? And set lower priority for batch preemptible jobs so they don't win the packing race.

ops-runner: Incident logged: INC-2026-gpu-packing-eu-west. Dashboards: https://grafana/redwood/gpu-pools?orgId=1. Alert runbook updated.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued to eu-west-canary at 1900460230 by maria.

alex: Cost estimate: churn ~ $900/day for eu-west. Quick patch should cut ~60% if canary is green.

maria: Running canary in eu-west-a at 1900460230. Will monitor PKT latency, CA events, and ENI quotas.

derek: If canary is green, rollout region-wide and open RFC for scheduler plugin + CA predicate.

li: I'll draft the RFC and include benchmark scenarios: mixed-MIG/time-slice A100 packing, ENI surge patterns, and cost sim.

alex: Thanks. Everyone watchers on alerts for next 45m and report any regression.

maria: Noted. Will post summary here after 30m. :thumbsup:
